LanguageData.CH_AutoReform: Select supplies when leaving a site too
LanguageData.CH_AutoReformTip: The game does not select supplies when you reform a caravan. This does.
LanguageData.CH_Days: Without a route, plan for a trip of {0} days
LanguageData.CH_DaysTip: When the caravan has no destination (for example when leaving a site).
LanguageData.CH_Return: Food for the way back too
LanguageData.CH_ReturnTip: When the destination is not your settlement, food for both ways is packed.
LanguageData.CH_NormalMedTip: The game takes the strongest medicine (glitterworld) first. Here ordinary and herbal medicine go, the rare kind stays home.
LanguageData.CH_AddictsTip: Addicted colonists (luciferium, go-juice …) take doses for the whole trip.
LanguageData.CH_Blockers: Show who keeps you from leaving
LanguageData.CH_BlockersTip: A button with everything the game counts as an enemy; click one to jump to it.
LanguageData.CH_LeaveSleeping: Leave past sleeping and hidden enemies
LanguageData.CH_LeaveSleepingTip: You can reform the caravan when no awake, visible, standing enemy is on the map. Sleeping mechanoids, insects in hives, enemies under fog and enemy buildings do not stop you.
LanguageData.CH_WhoBlocksDesc: Everything the game counts as an enemy on this map. Click a name to jump to it.
LanguageData.CH_ChooseExit: Choose the map exit side when forming a caravan
LanguageData.CH_ChooseExitTip: Adds an 'Exit' button to the form caravan window: the caravan leaves the map through the chosen edge (the reachable cell nearest to your pawns). Automatic keeps the game's choice. The route on the world map is chosen as usual.
LanguageData.CH_ShareTip: When a caravan enters a map, items are moved between its members so every colonist carries what his drug policy ('take to inventory') and his inventory stock (medicine …) ask for – taken from pack animals and from those who have more than they need.
LanguageData.CH_ExitTip: Which map edge the caravan walks out through. Automatic = the game's choice. The route on the world map does not change.
LanguageData.CH_ExitNone: No reachable exit on the {0} edge – the caravan uses the game's exit instead.
LanguageData.CH_KeepTravelFood: Travel food is not eaten at home
LanguageData.CH_KeepTravelFoodTip: The food you chose as travel food stays in storage at home – nobody eats it or puts it in a pocket, only someone who is starving. On the road, in the caravan and on other maps it is eaten as usual.
LanguageData.CH_GearPerTip: How many of each chosen equipment item a caravan takes for every colonist (with automatic supplies).
LanguageData.CH_TravelFoodDesc: Ticked food is kept for caravans: nobody eats it at home (unless starving) and caravans pack it first.
LanguageData.CH_TravelGearDesc: Ticked equipment is packed into every caravan with automatic supplies – the number per colonist is set in the settings.
